basic_info.description: xcellent opportunity in San Francisco's Outer Richmond area, this 2 bedroom and 1 bath home offers a compelling entry into the thriving San Francisco market for buyers with the willingness to update or expand the home. With its desirable location and versatile layout, this property presents a promising opportunity for forward-thinking homeowners looking to capitalize on the city's dynamic real estate landscape. The home includes a first level social room with an room to expand,  a rear yard and partial ocean views.    Offering excellent access to an array of amenities and attractions. Just moments away, residents can enjoy the serenity of Golden Gate Park, indulge in the diverse culinary scene along bustling Balboa Street, or explore the iconic Ocean Beach. The area also boasts convenient access to public transportation and is in close proximity to sought after schools, making it an ideal choice for homeowners. With its blend of urban conveniences and natural beauty, this outer Richmond home provides an enticing backdrop for prospective buyer.
